description: Visual staging of actor sprites (living world, scripts/Living/Actors/ActorStaging.cs). Visual only, never rules. hero_mask2020_rooms: rooms where Adam wears the 2020 face mask (outdoors among people, and inside the 2020 school S53 / S54 after the entry rule 'Dnes rúška a dezinfekcia', ISSUES PT-S28; game.json has no flag, see ISSUES ART-ADAM-02). hero_coat1982_rooms: rooms where Adam wears his winter coat and scarf (December 1982 with snow, ISSUES PT-S20): the 1982 exteriors S57, S58, S61, S62, S64, S66 and the issue room S65, a short errand straight from the S62 yard; the school interiors S59, S60 and S63 keep the jacket (*_coat1982 sheets, same timing and geometry as the default ones). hero_coat2035_rooms: the same coat and scarf in winter Jasna 2035 (6 February 2035, owner 2026-10-06 "Jasna 2035 is in winter"): the exteriors S41, S42, S45, S48, S50, the open Priehyba station hall S67 and the unheated Funitel cabin S68; the heated interiors S43, S44, S46, S47 and S49 keep the jacket. placements: per room and character: variant (actor.json variants), sill_y (canvas y of the painted window sill a bust stands on), scale (absolute, else room perspective), offset_x, facing (left/right, else face the hero). variants_after: per character, a list of {after: action id, variant: actor.json variant} applied in order once the action is done, {base} = the placement / manifest default variant (BF_JANA after Q9C, ISSUES ART-AGE-04).
